description: This file is a PHP class defining the admin controller for managing comments in the CMS module of the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing, approving, marking as spam, deleting comments, and updating comment ratings, tailored to comment moderation functionality.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments in the administration panel, providing functions for comment moderation such as listing, approving, marking spam, deleting, and refreshing ratings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up and renders the main comment management page with data such as breadcrumbs and URLs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of comments in response to an AJAX request.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and processes comment data, applying filters, and generates the comment list view with pagination.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves selected comments, changing their status to approved and updating related customer comments.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam, disabling them and optionally deleting customer comments.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected comments from the system.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Refreshes the rating counts for comments within a paginated subset.
